# Lucide Icons

The check-in icons (`il_clock`, `il_crown`, `il_shuffle`, `il_ticket`, `il_star`,
`il_plus`, `il_minus` and `ic_check`) are Android vector conversions of the
corresponding official Lucide SVG icons, with the existing app's stroke styling.

Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/main/icons

No icon font or additional rendering dependency is bundled.
